Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.

Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain life.

2034-4772-5320.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.

Resolve the Karmic Guide token's trigger, returning the nontoken Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, creating two token copies of Dance of Many that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.

Resolve one Dance of Many trigger, creating a token copy of Astral Dragon.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times, creating an additional Dance of Many trigger on the stack each loop.
Once you have infinite Dance of Many triggers, resolve them all, creating infinite copies of all nontoken creatures.
As you are resolving the triggers, you may also target Astral Dragon any number of times to create infinite copies of all noncreature permanents that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
At the beginning of your upkeep, pay {U}{U} for each Dance of Many or sacrifice that permanent and exile its associated creature token.
